messages.subject: uvažanje podatkov iz .xls in xlsx datotek
messages.subject_clean: uvažanje podatkov iz .xls in xlsx datotek
messages.body_plain:
Danes sem malo testiral različne rešitve za branje .xls in .xlsx datotek v R. Pot mi je prikrižal paket XLConnect. Dela skoraj iz škatlice (potrebuje Javo in še nekaj paketkov), kar ne bi smelo delati problemov večini uporabnikov.

Uporaba je preprosta:

> wb <- loadWorkbook("c:/file.xlsx")
> my.df <- readWorksheet(wb, "Sheet1")

Funkcija readWorksheet ima še cel kup argumentov, s katerimi lahko natančno izberete kater del datoteke boste prebrali.

lp,
Roman

--
In God we trust, all others bring data.

messages.subject: nice paper
messages.body_plain:
Hi rkoholiks,

Here is a nice paper about factors and mechanisms explaining spatial heterogeneity:
http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.2041-210X.2010.00059.x/abstract
Although this paper focusses on insect population I think it is applicable to all types of populations.

The pdf is freely available. Furthermore all the methods shown in the text can be done with R.
See http://cran.r-project.org/web/views/Spatial.html
and http://glmm.wikidot.com/faq

lp,

Maarten
